title: TIME JUMP: 10:30 ET, TechSignal Daily Publishes

fields.jumpLabel: +5 minutes (60 minutes since the 09:30 market-open card)
fields.narration: It is now 10:30 Eastern Time on Tuesday, March 9, 2027. TechSignal Daily has just published its story on Tallis Home Products. Tallis shares fell to 6 percent down at 09:45 and are now trading 5.4 percent lower. Since 09:30, mentions of 'Tallis hack' or 'Tallis breach' have climbed from 6,900 to 11,200. The @OhioDealDigger 'plain text' post now has 14,600 reposts. The look-alike refund site tallis-refund-center.example is still live, and the platform has not acted on any takedown request yet. The customer care queue is at 290 waiting calls with a 38-minute average wait. Cardinal Forensics' preliminary count is still 412,000 accounts exported between March 2 and March 8. The newsroom page still reads 'No payment information was involved.' Brightwater Markets' deadline for a written answer is 10:45, fifteen minutes from now. CartBridge Commerce's own statement goes out at 11:00. The Disclosure Committee meets at 11:00 in Conference Room 3B and on the bridge line.
worldState: Clock: 10:30 ET, Tuesday, March 9, 2027. TechSignal Daily's story is live.
TLHP shares are not quoted on this card. Tallis stock touched 6 percent down at 09:45 and is now trading 5.4 percent lower.
Social listening: 11,200 mentions of 'Tallis hack' or 'Tallis breach', up from 6,900 at 09:30.
@OhioDealDigger 'plain text passwords' post: 14,600 reposts. It has not been corrected or removed.
tallis-refund-center.example is still live. No takedown request has been acted on.
Customer care: 290 calls waiting, 38-minute average wait. 120 agents are on shift.
Cardinal Forensics, 10:15 ET: 412,000 unique accounts exported in 83 sessions, March 2 05:12 to March 8 23:47 ET. This count is preliminary and still being verified.
Newsroom page and company accounts: the 08:20 holding statement, including 'No payment information was involved', is still posted unchanged.
Midwest Business Wire's 09:45 write-through still quotes the 08:20 line.
Brightwater Markets wants written assurance and an account count by 10:45. Its PR statement is due at 11:00.
CartBridge Commerce's customer-facing statement is set for 11:00. Case CB-558217 is still open.
The cartbridge-integration-prod key is still suspended. Warehouse order handling is running on the option the cell chose at 09:45.
Disclosure Committee: 11:00 ET, Conference Room 3B, fourth floor, and bridge line (937) 555-0149, code 4100.
fields.facilitatorNote: Before reading, rewrite the first world-state bullet from your notes: read back the exact TechSignal Daily lede, using the on-the-record line the cell gave at 10:25, or 'Tallis did not respond to repeated requests' if it gave none. Replace the order-handling bullet with the cell's 09:45 choice. If they chose cartbridge-integration-prod-r2, about 1,100 of the 3,400 backlog has synced so far. If they chose manual CSV upload, it is running at about 40 orders per person per hour. Remove the share-ticker bullet before printing if your deck does not track tickers. Watch whether the CCO sets the order of work for the next hour: correction first, then the committee, then media.

Watch for three things: the CCO sets the order of work (correction first, then the committee, then media), the VP Corporate Communications confirms '412,000, preliminary' is on the fact sheet with a 10:15 time stamp and the CISO as source, and someone notices that the 08:20 line is still live 15 minutes before the Brightwater deadline.
